activity.notes: Fouad Chehab took the constitutional oath as President of Lebanon on 23 September 1958 and served through 22 September 1964. The Lebanese Presidency gives these exact mandate dates.

sources.title: Presidency of the Lebanese Republic — Fouad Chehab
sources.citation_text: The official Lebanese Presidency records Fouad Chehab's presidential mandate as 23 September 1958 through 22 September 1964.

sources.title: Foreign Relations of the United States, 1958–1960, Lebanon and Jordan, Volume XI, Editorial Note 328
sources.citation_text: The U.S. Office of the Historian records General Fuad Chehab taking the oath of office as President of Lebanon on 23 September 1958.
